name: scenario_c2_lake_raid
title: The lake raid in the storm
about: A stormy afternoon (rain, wind, lightning) at the big crocodile lake in the north-east, where the level-6 vehicle factory stands on a peninsula. The factory and its flag are blue; a blue laser squad and a tough squad hold its door, grunts hold its east shore, a heavy tank rolls out, psychos wait behind the factory. It starts far away and calm: a red column (two mechs, psychos, an electrobot, pyros) rolls up the ring road from the south and a missile launcher crawls in from the east, the forces well apart; the first shots fall at the neck of the peninsula as the psychos and the heavy meet, the launcher's salvos and the electrobot's bolts join, the mechs drive up the lake road, the door grunts counter-attack, and the blue heavy blows up at the neck (the turret debris blast). As the column breaks in, the blue grunts of the east shore run for it through the lake's east bay: the crocodiles take two of them on the way (the slow roll, the fast dive), seen across the water, and the rockets of the red toughs on the far shore take the third. The fight at the door is the climax: the mechs through the door, the lasers' bolts, the electrobot's jolts, the pyros' flames, the blue psychos arriving, a second blast. Four shots, each at RTS distance: a high wide establishing shot from the south-west, a side tracking shot along the lake road, a shot across the water at the crocodile attack, and a descending sweep from the east round the south to the south-west that ends wide.

camera.note: shot 1 (0-7 s): HIGH WIDE establishing shot from far south-west, the forces apart: the whole lake with the factory on its peninsula in the upper middle, the red column on the ring road in the lower left rolling north, the launcher crawling in on the right, the blue heavy rolling out, rain sheets across the frame; a slow push; the first shots at the neck near the end of the shot

shot 2 (7-13.5 s): SIDE TRACKING shot from the south along the lake road: mech 1 crosses the junction and drives east along the road from left to right, the lens tracks with it, the psychos and the electrobot ahead at the neck meeting the blue heavy, the launcher's first salvos from the right, the door grunts coming down to the neck, the factory and the lake behind; the heavy blows up at 12.5 s

shot 3 (13.5-21.5 s): ACROSS THE WATER from the south-east, looking north over the east bay (the door fight out of the frame on the left): the blue grunts of the east shore run for it through the bay as the column breaks in, the crocodile rises and takes one with the slow roll (about 16 s), a second one goes in the fast dive (about 19 s), the rockets of the toughs on the far shore burst in the water; the north rim behind; a slow push forward and down

shot 4 (21.5-28 s): DESCENDING SWEEP from high in the east round the south to the south-west, the lens always on the firing side of the lasers (west of the door, firing east and south-east): the fight at the door (the mechs through the door, the lasers' bolts towards the lens, the electrobot's jolts, the blue psychos arriving, the pyros' flames at the neck), the second blast at 25 s, ending wide over the junction with the whole peninsula, the lake and the east rim
the last framing: wide from the south-west, the whole peninsula and the lake

units.note: the missile launcher in the east, north-east of the robot factory of zone 5, out of every blue reach (30 m from the door grunts); ordered at 2 s to crawl north-west to the lake road's east end: its salvos (20 m) at the heavy and the door grunts at the neck from about 8 s, later at the toughs; it never comes within 70 m of a lens

psychos beside the ring road, 31 m from the toughs at frame 0; ordered at 1.5 s: they lead the rush to the neck, the heavy's gun and the toughs' rockets answer from about 7 s (the first shots of the take)
the electrobot west of the ring road, ordered at 3 s: its charge and bolts (18 m) at the heavy and the toughs at the neck from about 10 s

mech 1 on the east ring road 20 m south of the junction, ordered at 1 s: north to the junction (about 9 s), east along the lake road (shot 2 tracks it), north up the stub and in through the door (about 20 s)
mech 2, 8 m behind mech 1, ordered at 2 s; blown up at 25 s at the neck or on the stub (the turret debris blast throws the robots round it)

pyros west of the junction (30 m from the toughs, 20 m from the fort's own blue units at x 119-122), ordered at 4 s along the lake road to the stub: they reach the neck fight at about 16 s and the stub in the last shot (their flames there)

two toughs holding the small land pocket at the lake's north-east corner (23 m from the east-shore grunts, 8 m outside their reach): their rockets (15 m) over the water at the blue grunts fleeing through the bay in shot 3 (rockets bursting in the water round the waders and the crocodile); the third wader falls to them

the laser squad west of the door, holding its place: fires (17 m) east and south-east at the psychos, the electrobot and the mechs at the neck and the stub to the end; the last shot's lens stays on that side (east, south, south-west), so the bolts go towards the lens
the toughs west of the stub, holding: their rockets at the psychos and the mechs
grunts at the door, holding until 8 s, then down the stub to the neck to meet the column: the fight at the neck in shot 2, round the heavy's blast

grunts on the factory's east shore (land to x 178), holding; at 9 s, as the column breaks into the neck, they run for it through the deep middle of the east bay (the crocodiles' water) towards the north shore, under the rockets of the red toughs on the pocket: catch 1 about 16 s (the slow roll), catch 2 about 19 s (the fast dive), seen across the water in shot 3; the third falls to the rockets

the heavy tank between the toughs and the stub, ordered at 3 s down to the neck (there at about 8 s): its gun (18 m) at the psychos is the first shot of the take; blown up at 12.5 s in shot 2 (the turret debris blast, robots within 5 m of its landing fly)
blue psychos behind the factory, holding (nothing comes within their reach before the last cut), ordered at 21.5 s (the cut to the last shot) to the door: fresh defenders into the last shot

setup.note: the lake zone (zone 2: the level-6 vehicle factory) is blue: its flag blue, the factory blue

cues.note: mech 1: the junction, east along the lake road, north through the door
the psychos lead the rush to the neck
the launcher crawls north-west to the lake road's east end and fires its salvos on the way as soon as the neck is within 20 m (about 8 s)
the heavy rolls down to the neck to meet the column
the electrobot to the neck: charge and bolts at the heavy and the toughs
the pyros along the lake road to the stub, fighting what they meet (their flames at the neck from about 16 s and at the stub in the last shot)
the door grunts counter-attack down the stub to the neck
the east-shore grunts flee through the deep middle of the bay (plain moves through the water) towards the north shore, under the rockets of the toughs on the pocket

the heavy blows up at the neck in shot 2 (mech 1 instead if the heavy fell before): the game's turret debris blast lands 3 to 4 s later within about 37 m; robots within 5 m of it fly (blast physics untouched)
catch 1: the slow roll in the middle of the bay, seen across the water in shot 3 (the wader nearest the middle of the frame that the lens sees)
catch 2: the fast dive, while catch 1 still rolls
the blue psychos come down to the door for the last shot (ordered at its cut: they hold behind the factory, far from every lens, until then)
the second blast at the neck or on the stub in the last shot (the turret debris blast again: the robots round it fly); mech 1 instead if mech 2 fell before
